description_good_justification: README describes Firefly III MCP as a bounded semantic read-only MCP server for Firefly III financial analysis, including scope, installation, compatibility and security boundaries. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: README documents installation and use; GitHub Issues accept feedback; CONTRIBUTING.md documents contributions. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/README.md
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents contribution, testing, security-reporting, dependency and release expectations. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents Python/uv requirements, canonical verification, mandatory regression testing and fail-closed MCP/HTTP/credential boundaries. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: The project is released under the MIT license. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved open-source license.
license_location_justification: The full license text is in LICENSE at the repository root. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: README documents purpose, compatibility, capability boundary, installation, security, verification and release behavior. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: README summarizes the exact 22-tool surface and links to docs/tools.md for the full input/output/bounds contract. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md
sites_https_justification: The project repository, issue tracker and release distribution are served over HTTPS by GitHub.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests provide public, searchable project discussion. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/issues
english_justification: Public documentation, commit messages and code comments are maintained in English.
maintained_justification: The repository is actively maintained with current source, CI, dependency automation and a public-release lifecycle. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/commits/main
repo_public_justification: The complete maintained source repository is public. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp
repo_track_justification: git tracks source changes and public history on GitHub.
repo_interim_justification: Interim changes are published as commits and pull requests between releases.
repo_distributed_justification: git is a distributed version-control system.
version_unique_justification: Public releases use unique SemVer versions, tags and immutable GitHub Release assets. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/releases
version_semver_justification: Release tags follow strict vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH Semantic Versioning and are validated against pyproject.toml. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
version_tags_justification: Published releases use matching strict SemVer git tags. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/tags
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md records user-visible changes and GitHub Releases publish versioned artifacts. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: There are no publicly known Firefly III MCP vulnerabilities requiring release-note identification.
report_process_justification: Bug reports and feature requests are accepted through GitHub Issues and documented in CONTRIBUTING.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues is the public issue tracker. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/issues
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues provides a public searchable archive with stable URLs.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents private reporting, required report information, response targets and coordinated disclosure. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting with a documented private fallback. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No public evidence of a received vulnerability report exists; SECURITY.md commits to an initial response target.
build_justification: scripts/verify.sh creates the locked environment, verifies package parity, compiles code/tests, runs Ruff and pytest with coverage, and builds a wheel. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/scripts/verify.sh
build_common_tools_justification: The documented build uses standard Python, uv, pytest, Ruff and Python packaging tooling.
build_floss_tools_justification: The build and test path uses open-source Python development tooling.
test_justification: The repository contains automated unit, contract and boundary tests. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/tree/main/tests
test_invocation_justification: ./scripts/verify.sh is the documented canonical verification entry point.
test_most_justification: The canonical verifier enforces at least 90% statement coverage for the maintained Python package.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions CI runs the canonical verifier on proposed changes and main. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires functional and boundary changes to add or update automated tests where practical.
tests_are_added_justification: The repository contains regression tests for configuration, API allowlisting, write rejection, tool annotations, output projection and compatibility behavior.
tests_documented_added_justification: The mandatory test expectation is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.
warnings_justification: The implementation is interpreted Python; compileall, Ruff and tests are fail-closed syntax/static/runtime gates.
warnings_fixed_justification: There is no compiler-warning stream for the maintained Python implementation.
warnings_strict_justification: Compiler warning-level flags do not apply to the maintained Python implementation.
know_secure_design_justification: Project-specific secure-design principles and their application are documented in docs/SECURE-DEVELOPMENT.md. https://github.com/X1pheR/firefly-iii-mcp/blob/main/docs/SECURE-DEVELOPMENT.md
know_common_errors_justification: Common vulnerability classes relevant to MCP, HTTP, credentials and financial-data exposure are documented with mitigations in docs/SECURE-DEVELOPMENT.md.
crypto_published_justification: Firefly III MCP does not implement or define a cryptographic algorithm or protocol.
crypto_call_justification: Application cryptography is delegated to standard HTTPS/TLS and platform release-attestation boundaries.
crypto_floss_justification: No cryptographic algorithm is implemented by Firefly III MCP.
crypto_keylength_justification: The project does not choose cryptographic key lengths.
crypto_working_justification: The project does not implement cryptographic algorithms.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The project does not select application cryptographic algorithms.
crypto_pfs_justification: The stdio server does not terminate TLS.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project does not implement user accounts or password storage.
crypto_random_justification: The project does not generate cryptographic keys, passwords or session secrets.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source and release distribution use HTTPS through GitHub and release assets publish checksums plus signed provenance.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release assets are HTTPS-delivered with SHA256SUMS and GitHub/Sigstore provenance produced by the release workflow.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known unresolved medium-or-higher project vulnerabilities and SECURITY.md documents a 60-day public-vulnerability remediation target.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: There are no known unresolved critical project vulnerabilities.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Credential material is file-backed, public CI uses synthetic fixtures, and Secret Scanning/Push Protection are enabled at the public repository gate.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL analyzes Python and GitHub Actions workflow code for the public repository.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL covers common vulnerability classes for the maintained languages and workflows.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Public release acceptance requires current CodeQL findings to be reviewed and blocking findings resolved or explicitly dispositioned.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL default setup runs continuously on maintained repository changes.
dynamic_analysis_justification: The project enforces high statement coverage but does not currently claim a dedicated fuzzer/property-testing program satisfying the Best Practices dynamic-analysis criterion.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The maintained code is Python rather than an unsafe-memory language requiring ASAN/Valgrind-style checks.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests use assertions, but the project does not claim pervasive production-runtime assertions solely for dynamic analysis.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: The project does not currently claim the dedicated dynamic-analysis criterion.
